content.p: The repeals and amendments made by this Schedule (other than items 2, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16 and 17) apply:
so far as they affect assessments—to assessments for the 2015-16 income year and all later income years; and
otherwise—to acts done or omitted to be done, or states of affairs existing, after the commencement of the repeals and amendments.
The repeals and amendments made by items 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16 and 17 of this Schedule apply in respect of securities issued on or after the commencement of this Schedule.
The object of this Division is to ensure that, despite the repeals and amendments made by this Schedule, the full legal and administrative consequences of:
any act done or omitted to be done; or
any state of affairs existing; or

before such a repeal or amendment applies, can continue to arise and be carried out, directly or indirectly through an indefinite number of steps, even if some or all of those steps are taken after the repeal or amendment applies.

hcontainer.name: item
hcontainer.heading: Making and amending assessments, and doing other things, in relation to past matters

content.p: Even though an Act is repealed or amended by this Schedule, the repeal or amendment is disregarded for the purpose of doing any of the following under any Act or legislative instrument:
making or amending an assessment (including under a provision that is itself repealed or amended);
exercising any right or power, performing any obligation or duty or doing any other thing (including under a provision that is itself repealed or amended);
in relation to any act done or omitted to be done, any state of affairs existing, or any period ending, before the repeal or amendment applies.

hcontainer.name: item
hcontainer.heading: Saving of provisions about effect of assessments

content.p: If a provision or part of a provision that is repealed or amended by this Schedule deals with the effect of an assessment, the repeal or amendment is disregarded in relation to assessments made, before or after the repeal or amendment applies, in relation to any act done or omitted to be done, any state of affairs existing, or any period ending, before the repeal or amendment applies.

hcontainer.name: item
hcontainer.heading: Repeals disregarded for the purposes of dependent provisions

content.p: If the operation of a provision (the subject provision) of any Act or legislative instrument depends to any extent on an Act, or a provision of an Act, that is repealed by this Act, the repeal is disregarded so far as it affects the operation of the subject provision.
